summary: After losing funds in a wallet draining scam, the victim contacted a purported cryptocurrency recovery service promoted through a Reddit community. The recovery operators claimed they could recover 75 percent of the stolen funds but required a 500 USD upfront payment and blocked the victim immediately after receiving the deposit.
user_mistake: Paid an upfront fee to a purported cryptocurrency recovery service
prevention: Assume unsolicited recovery services are fraudulent / Never pay advance fees for recovery of stolen cryptocurrency
